Damayhs (also spelled Damays in some scripts) has been killed, and Nymessa is a fellow tiefling who knew him and reacts aloud to his death. Earlier events off-screen include tieflings (including Damays and Nymessa) being dragged into fighting from another situation and others like Dammon or Danis taking part in arming or defending the group.
